About

More than just another developer.

I'm the kind of person who gets excited by ideas — the ones that suddenly appear while listening to music, scrolling through random articles, or even in the middle of a conversation.

Most of them stay as thoughts. Some become sketches. The lucky ones become projects.

I don't believe great software begins with code. I believe it begins with curiosity. Every project I build starts with a simple question: "What if this could be better?"

That question has led me through late-night debugging sessions, countless Google searches, moments of frustration, and even bigger moments of excitement when everything finally works.

For me, technology has never been just about programming. It's about understanding problems, finding creative solutions, and building things that make someone's day a little easier.

I'm still learning, still exploring, and still making mistakes — but I wouldn't trade that journey for anything. Every challenge teaches me something new, and every project reminds me why I chose this path in the first place.

This website isn't simply a portfolio. It's a snapshot of where I am today, the projects I'm proud of, and the developer I'm slowly becoming.

💡 Curious before confident.

Off Duty

Beyond the screen.

Outside of my laptop, life looks a little different. I love getting lost in music that matches my mood, reading stories that make me think differently, and exploring new places whenever I get the chance.

I'm someone who notices the little details — whether it's a beautifully designed interface, an elegant animation, or the tiny things that make a product feel effortless to use.

I believe inspiration can come from anywhere, and some of my best ideas arrive when I'm not trying to think about code at all.
